findings.description: A fresh50ms settlement window is not bounded by absolute child-case60s and batch300s deadlines. The loop checks case time before native sampling; settlement can then accept an exact exit after case expiry but before its own50ms deadline. A later guard.next may reset the watchdog before its next50ms observation.
findings.staticExample: Unavailable sample near59.99s; exact exit at60.02s accepted within settlement50ms, then child_case breaks without an absolute post-settlement case check. This is reasoning, not an executed reproduction.
findings.requestedChange: Compose min(settlement-start+50ms, absolute case deadline, absolute batch deadline), checking strictly before and after every poll. Never extend/reset case or batch deadline. Add pure injected-clock near-case and near-batch expiry/equality cases.
findings.closure: Settlement now capped by original guard stage/batch and explicit caller batch deadlines. Child immediate poll, native sample, settlement, sleep, post-loop and pre-return receipt paths enforce strict absolute expiry; guard.next cannot forgive an expired previous stage.
